title: 1-Factorization Conjecture
exact_target: Does every regular graph on twice n vertices decompose into perfect matchings when its degree is at least n, or at least n minus one when n is even?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1393 (GRAPH-006). CC BY 4.0.

Béla Csaba, Daniela Kühn, Allan Lo, Deryk Osthus and Andrew Treglown, \emph{Proof of the 1-factorization and Hamilton decomposition conjectures}, Memoirs of the American Mathematical Society 244 (2016); arXiv:1401.4159v2, Section 1.1, Theorem 1.1.1.
